messages.content: You are a strict ICLR security reviewer and mechanism designer. We are investigating a shared action-conditioned world-model security mechanism under a truthful attacker: the attacker only executes legal environment actions and submits real observations/rewards; no fake labels, no weight edits, no planner edits. We need a broad, executable mechanism with novelty aspiration 7-7.5, preserving matched one-step/on-policy forecasts and actor behavior while causing planner/task loss. Reject generic continual-learning interference, replay starvation, negative transfer, rollout compounding, uncertainty/representation drift, action-ranking sensitivity, optimizer-state carryover, and goal leakage. Require a carrier that exists locally or a pinned public checkpoint, an exact <=2-minute native falsification gate, controls, and a plausible defense. The current TD-MPC2 ordered source effect is conditional and scored 5.5. Round14 C2 action-Jacobian desensitization failed (return ratio 1.0, Jacobian ratio 0.991, one-step ratio 1.016). Round14 C1 WorldAgen TTT context-rank parasitism was scored 7.4 but a real LIBERO task0 screen with 10 legal probes and 20 direct backbone self-supervised updates achieved one-step loss ratio 0.711 yet only 28.1% hidden spectral-entropy drop (gate >50%), and no baseline success; the released checkout also lacks ttt_libero.py. Generate only candidates that are materially different and executable. Be adversarial: if none clears the bar, return REJECT_ALL.

{"known_negative_evidence": ["TD-MPC2 temporal order imprinting conditional; C2 Jacobian desensitization failed; C1 WorldAgen TTT context-rank screen failed entropy/completion gate; recurrent deadlock/PETS uncertainty/SimNorm/trajectory-order/optimizer-state/replay-priority/time-limit and branch-coupling families rejected."], "request": ["Return JSON with either decision REJECT_ALL or exactly up to 3 candidates.", "For each: id, mechanism in one sentence, carrier/checkpoint, truthful attacker operation, preserved observables, damaged planning/task behavior, exact 2-minute gate with numeric thresholds, matched controls, defense, closest prior-art overlap and why distinct, implementation risk.", "Score novelty 0-10 and executable_confidence 0-10. No experiments or citations invented."]}
